page.overview:
Who is Phaedra Vye?

Phaedra Vye was a member of the Janusian Faithful.

Phaedra Vye travelled to Arrakis alongside other nobles including Mon Torsival, Marara Torbin, Priorin Tannat, Len Artuni, Agade Yimari, Ogdan Barbalescu, Menoria Tamar, Venesir Ask, Roella Ramsby, Eulalia Harthorn, Ansel Virro, Bianca Bagetti, Oona Byrn and Hesperia Farani. The group were very secretive, refusing to dine with House Atreides, attend the salons or allow anyone outside their group to dine with them.

Phaedra Vye become acquainted with Osten Laithe, later becoming his lover. He told her his deepest secrets and she asked him for money to buy back her family's heirlooms from House Harkonnen. The Prisoner investigated Laithe's workshop and Vye's aparement on the orders of Sub-Prefect Tors. In the apartment, they discovered a secret room where they found Vye's corpse with a blade buried in her neck.

Category:Dune Awakening Awakening Awakening
